svg.aria-label: Lowering answers each requested node on its own with one of five records: lowered, unsupported when a reachable family is outside the profile, requires_bound when a reachable type is unbounded, invalid_input when the key is not in the package, or failed when the work or byte budget runs out. A request that cannot lower adds nothing to the package.
